name: tinto-add-new-tour
description: Creating a brand-new Tours record in Airtable when a client signs on for a tour that doesn't exist yet: destination, dates, status, price, capacity, pickup/drop-off, cover-page content, and a generated slug, confirmed one question at a time before writing anything. For a brand-new client, hands off to tinto-add-winery-record rather than duplicating that research. Once a tour's Room Block already exists (built by tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms at the point of sale), converts it into real, priced Packages rows too, confirming Double and Solo pricing against either a figure Peter already confirmed for this tour's own pitch-stage PDF, or, failing that, the same destination's most recent tour, rather than the hotel's own rate quote. Doesn't touch the day-by-day Itinerary Days (tinto-client-itinerary-pdf owns that) or hotel-side room holding and capacity (Room Blocks, Hotel Room Inventory, owned by tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms) or taking a tour live for online booking (tinto-booking-pages), or linking the tour's suppliers (Tamara's handover step, tinto-confirm-supplier-pairings, picked up automatically from her daily supplier summary).
